New listing (Published: February 27, 2026)

A market will be held at Hanno Komachi Park to coincide with the Hanno Hinamatsuri Doll Display exhibition. Food trucks will be on site selling a variety of items including shaved ice, crepes, kebab, spare ribs, and more. The market runs on February 28 (Saturday), March 1 (Sunday), March 7 (Saturday), and March 8 (Sunday). There is no parking at the venue, so please use nearby paid parking lots or coin-operated parking. Vendor offerings may change due to weather or other conditions.
